item.text: [{"task_id":"278e5215","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    bg = int(round(params['rule'][0]))","    mark = int(round(params['rule'][1]))","    step = int(round(params['rule'][2]))","    palette_row = int(round(params['rule'][3]))","    fill_row = int(round(params['rule'][4]))","    points = np.argwhere(grid == mark)","    legend = np.argwhere((grid != bg) & (grid != mark))","    if len(points) == 0 or len(legend) == 0 or step <= 0:","        return grid.copy()","    r0 = int(np.min(points[:, 0]))","    r1 = int(np.max(points[:, 0])) + step","    c0 = int(np.min(points[:, 1]))","    c1 = int(np.max(points[:, 1])) + step","    lr0 = int(np.min(legend[:, 0]))","    lr1 = int(np.max(legend[:, 0])) + step","    lc0 = int(np.min(legend[:, 1]))","    lc1 = int(np.max(legend[:, 1])) + step","    key = grid[lr0:lr1, lc0:lc1]","    mask = grid[r0:r1, c0:c1]","    if key.shape[1] != mask.shape[1]:","        return grid.copy()","    if palette_row < -key.shape[0] or palette_row >= key.shape[0]:","        return grid.copy()","    if fill_row < -key.shape[0] or fill_row >= key.shape[0]:","        return grid.copy()","    palette = key[palette_row, :]","    fill = key[fill_row, :]","    return np.where(mask == mark, palette, fill)"],"shapes":{"rule":[5]},"params":{"rule":[0,5,1,0,-1]},"rationale":"Crop the gray pattern to its bounding box.
